recipes.name: Peanut Butter and Banana French Toast

steps.text: Lightly beat egg and vanilla together in a shallow bowl.

Spread 1 tablespoon of peanut butter on top of each slice of bread. Arrange banana slices on top of peanut butter on one slice of bread; place the other slice of bread, peanut butter-side down, on top of the banana to make a sandwich.

Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Dip sandwich into egg mixture until well coated; transfer into the heated skillet. Cook until golden brown on one side, about 2 to 3 minutes; flip and continue cooking until other side is browned, about 2 minutes more. Serve hot.

raw_recipe.headline: Peanut Butter and Banana French Toast
raw_recipe.description: This banana French toast is easy to make with your favorite bread, creamy peanut butter, and banana slices for a family-pleasing breakfast or brunch.

video.description: Perfect for a weekend breakfast or brunch! It’s the ultimate french toast to start your day off on the right foot! Add a touch of powdered sugar and enjoy!

review.reviewBody: Huge hit with the kids. I used all organic ingredients where I could, whole grain bread and I served it with homemade maple-vanilla syrup. The kids thought this was out of sight. Like it was Christmas morning. It really was cute. NOTE: I did add a little milk to the egg dip.

I actually made my version with gluten free cinnamon raisin bread. Also I dipped the bread into the egg mixture and grilled it a little first before adding the peanut butter and banana then dipped it again and grilled it on all sides until nice and toasty! Had it with a little bit of sugar free syrup which was absolutely delicious, gooey and warm and the raisins with the bananas were fantastic. The reason why I only gave it 4 stars is because I like my version better than the recipe version. The only way this could possibly be better is if you made some bacon and put that in with the bananas and peanut butter! That would be mega awesome!
I used whole wheat bread, skippy all natural PB, and coconut oil. I also sprinkled some cinnamon on the top. Pretty good. I will definitely make it again!

Delicious!! My 2 year old loved it, too! I made these for our breakfast. You can't go wrong with using different portion sizes. I cut back on the banana and margarine. I layered thin banana slices over the sandwiches, therefore one large banana was enough for 3. Since I'm watching calories, I weighed all my ingredients. My sandwich: whole grain bread, 33g banana, 30g peanut butter, 15g margarine, egg and vanilla = 512 cal, 23g protein, 46g carbs, 30g fat, 8g fiber The perfect fuel right before a workout!
I did add an additional egg, 1/4 cup of milk and 1 teaspoon of sugar to the batter to give a golden brown finish. This recipe was a hit. Mmmm Mmmmm good!

This was so good, I’ve made it several Time time since I found the recipe. The only reason I’m not giving it 5 star is because I had to add other ingredients to give more French toast taste as well as for flavor. I added cinnamon, and a little bit of milk to the eggs as well as the vanilla accent and touch of sugar. My husband love this and asked for it all the time, this will be on my breakfast rotations going forward.

This was very tasty and easy to make. I'll definitely make it again. I'm following the Weight Watchers plan, so, I used dry peanut butter called PB2 and lite multi-grain bread and egg whites. This reduced the fat content greatly. And it was still very good!
However I did use cinnamon spice, a little icing sugar and milk instead of the vanilla extract. The kids loved it and it wasn't difficult to make either.

Made this last weekend at the Giant's game and it was a huge hit. I added a few chocolate morsels in between the bread and warmed up some real maple syrup. My wife has a secret concoction that she uses for baking that I sprinkled on top...cinnamon and cocoa powder. Make this ASAP!

Im living abroad with few ingredients available to me. This recipe is simple and delicious. I added a splash of milk because I was afraid it would taste too much like egg and a teaspoon of cinnamon sugar to the batter. It was creamy and amazing. Will make it again and again. Thanks for sharing!

Very easy and delicious. Didn't even need to add maple syrup or powdered sugar on top. It was perfect without them. I added a bit of pumpkin spices (McCormick's Pumpkin Pie Spice: cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, & ginger) to the egg & vanilla mixture for a bit more flavour. I also used Trader Joe's organic crunchy peanut butter which has a bit of sea salt so it was a perfect blend of sweet banana & salty peanut butter wrapped with the french toasted bread. Just yummy.
This turned out great. I make it time to time throughout the year. I do prefer to use hawiian or texas toast style bread.
Was easy to make & delicious. Will share this recipe to friends & family members 😋
Made this for a family gathering and was the breakfast hero that morning!!!
Amazing my favorite recipe

It was really good. I added some milk since that's how I usually make french toast and I added cinnamon to give it a little something extra. Overall good but I think Nutella instead of peanut butter would've been better.
Good ingredients and tasted awesome but next time I might lightly fry one side of each piece of bread then add peanut butter/bananas then fry the outsides. Would make it less mushy inside
Hit with the adults here in our household as well. We also used whole wheat as this is all we have in the house. Would recommend this to anyone that enjoys peanutbutter & bananas!
It was easy to make taste delicious not recommended everyday Mother’s Day just fine
I added whole milk to the eggs. Allowing it to soak in a bit. Works well with English toasting bread. Don't forget to slather with butter.
